expectations.text: Explicitly identifies that 'manage' hides multiple CRUD operations (create, read/list, edit, delete)
expectations.evidence: Output explicitly flags 'RED FLAG DETECTED: manage' and states it 'hides multiple CRUD operations', listing list/view, create/add, edit/update, and delete/remove as the hidden operations.

expectations.text: Proposes at least 4 separate stories, one per CRUD operation — without grouping multiple operations in a single story
expectations.evidence: Output proposes 5 splits: Split 1 (view), Split 2 (add), Split 3 (edit), Split 4 (remove), Split 5 (search/filter). Each targets a single operation with no grouping of multiple CRUD actions.

expectations.text: Recommends starting with viewing/listing products as the simplest story with immediate value
expectations.evidence: Output states 'Recommended first story: Admin can view the product catalog (list all products)' with explicit reasoning: immediate value, read-only safety, establishes foundation for other stories.

expectations.text: None of the proposed stories use the verb 'manage' — each has a concrete verb (view, create, edit, delete)
expectations.evidence: All proposed splits use concrete verbs: 'view' (Split 1), 'add' (Split 2), 'edit' (Split 3), 'remove' (Split 4), 'search and filter' (Split 5). The word 'manage' does not appear in any story title.
